## CommonFormatter.trailingZero() method

Enables or disables trailing zeros in the formatted output.

This method modifies the formatter's configuration to remove or keep unnecessary trailing zeros from decimal numbers based on the `enable` parameter. A new formatter instance is created with this option enabled or disabled.

**Signature:**

```typescript
trailingZero(enable?: boolean): this;
```

**Returns:**

this

A new formatter instance with the `removeTrailingZero` option set to the opposite of `enable`<!-- -->.

## Example 1

const updatedFormatter = formatter.trailingZero(false); console.log(updatedFormatter.of(123.4500)); // Output: "123.45"

## Example 2

const updatedFormatterDisabled = formatter.trailingZero(true); console.log(updatedFormatterDisabled.of(123.4500)); // Output: "123.4500"
